    FREE = "free", "Free"
    PRO = "pro", "Pro"


class InvoiceState(models.TextChoices):
    NEW = "new", "New"
    PAID = "paid", "Paid"
    VOID = "void", "Void"


class Currency(models.TextChoices):
    USD = "USD", "Usd"
    EUR = "EUR", "Eur"


class Customer(models.Model):
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(db_default=Now())
    created_by = models.CharField(max_length=50, null=True, blank=True)
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    email = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    nickname = models.CharField(max_length=255, null=True, blank=True)
    tier = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=CustomerTier.choices, default=CustomerTier.FREE)
    credit = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    prefs = models.JSONField(default=dict)
    birthday = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    wakes_at = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    lifetime = models.DurationField(null=True, blank=True)
    avatar = models.BinaryField(null=True, blank=True)
    score = models.FloatField(db_default=0.5)
    visits = models.BigIntegerField(db_default=0)
    rank = models.IntegerField(default=1)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(db_default=True)
    external_id = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4)
    referrer = models.ForeignKey("Customer", on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="referrals")
    following = models.ManyToManyField("Customer", related_name="followers", blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "customers"
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=["email", "name"], name="uq_customers_email_name"),

    kind = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    line1 = models.CharField(max_length=120)
    line2 = models.CharField(max_length=120, null=True, blank=True)

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey("customer", "kind")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "addresses"

class Invoice(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    number = models.CharField(max_length=32)
    state = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=InvoiceState.choices, default=InvoiceState.NEW)
    currency = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=Currency.choices, default=Currency.USD)
    issued_on = models.DateField(default=timezone.now)
    subtotal = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2)
    tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total = models.GeneratedField(expression=subtotal + tax, output_field=models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2), db_persist=True)
    ship_region = models.CharField(max_length=10, null=True, blank=True)
    ship_code = models.CharField(max_length=10, null=True, blank=True)
    customer = models.ForeignKey("Customer", on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    billing_customer = models.ForeignKey("Customer", on_delete=models.DO_NOTHING, null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "invoice"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["issued_on"], name="ix_invoice_issued"),
        ]

class Book(models.Model):
    isbn = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True)
    id = models.OneToOneField("Product", on_delete=models.DO_NOTHING, db_column="id", primary_key=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "books"


class LineItem(models.Model):
    quantity = models.IntegerField(default=1)
    invoice = models.ForeignKey("Invoice", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="items")
    product = models.ForeignKey("Product", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="items")
    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey("invoice", "product")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "line_items"

    body = models.TextField()
